modelDescription: Delivering the unmatched knockdown power of both Weatherby Magnum and standard calibers. Providing the confidence of guaranteed SUB-MOA accuracy. Add in a match quality, two-stage trigger that breaks crisp and clean. That's why the Vanguard has become one of the most popular rifle options today. Shoulder a Weatherby Vanguard and see for yourself the best rifle value on the market today.
